title: The Sacrifice of the New Creation - 2
Prayer
text:
Most gracious heavenly Father,
You have set the measure of the offering to rise with the greatness of the sacrifice.

Search us, and show us where our knowledge has grown large but our devotion has stayed small.

Let our character, our walk in Your Spirit, and our poured-out love all rise together.

To whom You have given much, You require much; make us faithful stewards of all we have received.

And where our resources are small, teach us the joy of the widow, who gave her all.

As our sight of Christ grows, let our whole offering grow gladly to meet it.

"From everyone to whom much is given, much will be required." Luke 12:48
